headline: Zeus Resources Acquires 51% Stake in Mauritania Copper-Gold Project
summary: Australian explorer Zeus Resources purchased a 51% interest in the Diaguili copper-gold project in Mauritania, where the exploration license is set to expire on November 6, 2026.
why: Junior resource explorers acquire early-stage permits in West Africa to position for rising global copper and gold demand amid the global energy transition.

impacts.name: Zeus Resources
impacts.why: Zeus Resources acquired a majority 51% controlling stake in the Diaguili copper-gold project.
